headline: 高登帕克斯攝影展登場
context: 為慶祝高登．帕克斯基金會成立20週年，紐約傑克．夏因曼畫廊（Jack Shainman Gallery）推出攝影展『鏡中之聲』（Voices in the Mirror），展出攝影師高登．帕克斯（Gordon Parks）的代表作品。伊莎貝拉．羅塞里尼、朗妮．阿里與安德森．庫柏等曾入鏡人物的親屬，也參與了這次展覽的相關討論。

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: Isabella Rossellini, Lonnie Ali, Anderson Cooper and other relatives of those who figured in the celebrated photographer’s portraiture bolster a new exhibition at the Jack Shainman Gallery.
sources.title: Gordon Parks as His Subjects Knew Him

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: As a new exhibition celebrates the 20th anniversary of the Gordon Parks Foundation, those who knew him discuss his most powerful images Gordon Parks was not only a renowned photographer but also a poet, composer, director and mentor to so many, past and present, a Renaissance man whose talent spanned disciplines. Born in Fort Scott, Kansas, Parks used his craft to illuminate the lives, worlds and humanity of people. He created the Gordon Parks Foundation with Life magazine editor Philip B Kunhardt Jr in 2006 to promote and support artistic and educational initiatives that advance his legacy and vision. In celebration of the foundation’s 20th anniversary, the Jack Shainman Gallery in New York will present the exhibit Gordon Parks: Voices in the Mirror. Continue reading...
sources.title: ‘He was making history, not copying it’: the greatest Gordon Parks photographs

threads_text:
為慶祝高登．帕克斯基金會成立20週年，紐約的傑克．夏因曼畫廊推出攝影展『鏡中之聲』（Voices in the Mirror），展出攝影師高登．帕克斯（Gordon Parks）的代表作品。帕克斯不只是攝影師，也是詩人、作曲家與導演，一生橫跨多個創作領域。伊莎貝拉．羅塞里尼、朗妮．阿里與安德森．庫柏等曾入鏡人物的親屬，也參與了這次展覽的相關討論，分享對他的回憶。

本則整理自 The New York Times 與 The Guardian 於 2026 年 9 月 18 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 紐約有一場攝影展，紀念攝影師高登．帕克斯。為了慶祝他的基金會成立20週年，紐約的一間畫廊推出攝影展『鏡中之聲』，展出他的代表作品。帕克斯不只是攝影師，也是詩人、作曲家與導演，創作橫跨好幾個領域。演員伊莎貝拉．羅塞里尼，還有安德森．庫柏等曾入鏡人物的親屬，也參與了這次展覽的討論，分享他們記憶中的帕克斯。
